infant_milk_dialog_content:
The World Health Organisation (WHO) Sale of Infant Foods Ethics Committee of Singapore (SIFECS) Code of Ethics Frequently asked questions on the sale of infant formula via online and electronic channels 2 and Health Promotion Board (HPB) recommends exclusive breastfeeding for the first six months of life. Unnecessary introduction of bottle feeding or other food and drinks will have a negative impact on breastfeeding. At around six months of age (but not before 4 months), infants should receive nutritionally adequate and age-appropriate complementary foods while breastfeeding continues for up to two years of age or beyond.

Shopee Singapore fully recognises breast milk’s primacy, value and superiority and supports exclusive breastfeeding as recommended by the WHO.

The content on this website is intended as general information for Singaporean residents only and should not be used as a substitute for medical care and advice from your healthcare practitioner.

The Health Promotion Board recommends that infants start on age-appropriate complementary foods at around 6 months, whilst continuing breastfeeding for up to 2 years or beyond to meet their evolving nutritional requirements. If no longer breastfeeding, toddlers can switch to full cream milk after 12 months. This should be complemented by a good variety of solid foods from the four main food groups (fruits, vegetables, grains, meat and alternatives). For more information on the nutritional requirements of infants and young children, please visit www.healthhub.sg/earlynutrition

label_fbs_pdp_content_desc_TW:
蝦皮直送訂單，將由蝦皮倉庫包裝出貨並且享有訂單付款成立後或成團後全力於24H內送達。不適用情形條款，請詳閱說明：

 1. 全台24小時配送服務，不適用於非"蝦皮宅配"之訂單
 2. 全台24小時配送服務說明如下：「全台24小時配送服務」（下稱本服務）的時效計算方式為：
自買家付款完成時間起算，至商品到貨為止，前述到貨時間應以物流業者回報之時點為準。但若有不符合本服務說明辦法（詳見第2至第5點），或有第6點所列之特殊情形者，則不適用本服務。
 3. 本服務適用的付款方式僅限於使用「信用卡」、「蝦皮錢包」、「街口支付」付款，取貨方式則僅接受「蝦皮宅配」的方式，且買家填寫的收件人地址資訊必需完整詳盡並可透過系統辨識。
 4. 本服務適用時段：(1)全台範圍－週日至週五：12:00 ~ 21:59 間完成付款；(2)台中(含)以北指定區域(試營運範圍)－週日至週五不限時段完成付款，將盡速於24小時內送達；以上如遇特殊假日將另行公布。
 5. 本服務適用商品：整體訂單商品含包材之材積，三邊加總需小於120公分，且重量含包材之總合小於20公斤。
 6. 不適用本服務的配送地區：離島地區、全台山區路段、服務性質受限營利場所(如公家機關、學校、機場、車站、醫院)

 7. 若遇配送繁盛期（如春節、中秋節等）、收件人未收貨、買家變更收件地址、蝦皮或物流業者的系統設備進行維護、倉庫盤點或儲位調整、有濫用本服務之虞者、或有颱風地震等不可抗力因素，皆不適用本服務。
 以上若含未詳盡之處，蝦皮購物將保留訂單成立之最終決定權。

label_pdp_content_TW:
蝦皮直送訂單，將由蝦皮倉庫包裝出貨並且享有訂單付款成立後或成團後全力於24H內送達。不適用情形條款，請詳閱說明：

 1. 全台24小時配送服務，不適用於非"蝦皮宅配"之訂單
 2. 全台24小時配送服務說明如下：「全台24小時配送服務」（下稱本服務）的時效計算方式為：
自買家付款完成時間起算，至商品到貨為止，前述到貨時間應以物流業者回報之時點為準。但若有不符合本服務說明辦法（詳見第2至第5點），或有第6點所列之特殊情形者，則不適用本服務。
 3. 本服務適用的付款方式僅限於使用「信用卡」、「蝦皮錢包」、「街口支付」付款，取貨方式則僅接受「蝦皮宅配」的方式，且買家填寫的收件人地址資訊必需完整詳盡並可透過系統辨識。
 4. 本服務適用時段：(1)全台範圍－週日至週五：12:00 ~ 21:59 間完成付款；(2)台中(含)以北指定區域(試營運範圍)－週日至週五不限時段完成付款，將盡速於24小時內送達；以上如遇特殊假日將另行公布。
 5. 本服務適用商品：整體訂單商品含包材之材積，三邊加總需小於120公分，且重量含包材之總合小於20公斤。
 6. 不適用本服務的配送地區：離島地區、全台山區路段、服務性質受限營利場所(如公家機關、學校、機場、車站、醫院)

 7. 若遇配送繁盛期（如春節、中秋節等）、收件人未收貨、買家變更收件地址、蝦皮或物流業者的系統設備進行維護、倉庫盤點或儲位調整、有濫用本服務之虞者、或有颱風地震等不可抗力因素，皆不適用本服務。
 以上若含未詳盡之處，蝦皮購物將保留訂單成立之最終決定權。

mbr_term_service_detail:
Brand Membership T&C

By agreeing to this T&C, you understand that the information you provide on the fields prompted by the “Join Brand Membership” page will be used for Brand Membership program purposes only. You authorize that Shopee may store and provide the information you submitted to the sellers or brand partners you have signed for membership with (or) their agencies through encrypted channels in order to provide you with services within and outside of the platform. Shopee will require the third parties mentioned to use your above-mentioned information in accordance with the law and shall keep your information confidential; and that Shopee will not be responsible for any misuse of the info by the third parties.
Membership Eligibility

1. The Brand Membership is a programme that is specific to and offered by an official shop. Each Brand Membership has differentiated tiers and reward structure. Tier eligibility is based on accumulated spending in the last 12 months. 

Each official shop reserves the right to design its Brand Membership programme through the following: the number of tiers, naming of tiers, spending thresholds for each tier, and rewards. 

Brand Membership is different from and independent of the Platform-wide membership programme (Shopee Rewards) or any other memberships such as Mom’s Club, Beauty Club, etc.

Once you have signed up for any Brand Membership within the platform, your basic membership status for that brand’s membership programme will have lifetime validity and cannot be cancelled.

You may cancel your membership for any brand at any time under the membership profile page.

After you cancel your membership, you will lose your membership tier and all remaining points. Additionally, you will no longer enjoy the membership benefits for the brand.

When you sign up for a membership from the same brand again, your previous membership progress would be lost and you will start from the basic tier. Sign up bonuses will not be applicable to repeat sign-ups.

You can only change your existing Brand Membership’s personal information (name, email, phone number, etc.) when you sign up for another Brand Membership. The new information will be updated automatically across all other Brand Memberships that you have previously signed up for. 

The membership information provided in each Brand Membership will not be synced with your Shopee Main Account information.

2. Members must fulfill the minimum spend (in “currency”) criteria set by the shop to earn qualifying points for the respective membership tiers.

Conversion of spending (in “currency”) to points ratio will vary between shops, and is subject to the shop’s discretion. 

Conversion ratio for each shop’s Brand Membership can be found via the “Membership Details” link at the end of the sign-up page, or via the Membership Card “View Tiers Benefits” section on the main Brand Membership page.

3. Qualifying Brand Membership points can be earned from:
- Completed order(s) from selected shops 
- Sign-up bonus for the Brand Membership programme (subject to shop’s discretion)

There will strictly be no qualifying points earned from returned, refunded or cancelled orders. Points will be rounded down to the nearest whole number.

The points earned from the Brand Membership programme can only be used to redeem Rewards offered by the brand’s official shop on the Shopee platform, and cannot be combined with or used to redeem Rewards from any offline or other online membership programme offered by the same seller or brand; and vice versa.

The points can only be used to redeem Rewards offered by the brand’s official shop and cannot be used to redeem Rewards on Shopee platform as a whole.

4. Shopee reserves the right to withhold the issuance of qualifying points earned until the qualifying transactions, including payment, are completed.

5. Brand Membership points are valid for 12 months from the earned date. The points shall qualify you for the applicable membership tier within the points valid period.

6. How to tier up or tier down 
- The 1st tier in all Brand Membership programmes are free to join and the status of this tier will be valid for a lifetime. 
- From the 2nd tier onwards, the tier status will be valid for twelve (12) months from the tier activation date or the successful upgrade or renewal of tier status.

Upon expiration of your membership tenure in a particular tier and if you have not earned sufficient qualifying points to be retained in that tier (as stated by each shop), you shall be downgraded to the next relevant membership tier.

7. The Brand Membership programme is non-transferable and shall be for personal use of the Shopee user only.

Rewards

8. How to redeem Rewards:
- Rewards are redeemable using Brand Membership points in each shop
- Rewards are customizable by the Shop and they may change without prior notice

Rewards must be claimed within their applicable validity period as set by the seller. There will be strictly no extension of validity period for Rewards, unless otherwise communicated by the seller.

Rewards can only be redeemed via Shopee app using the points accumulated via shop-specific Brand Membership programme.

9. The shop reserves the right to offer shop-specific Rewards that can include one or a combination of the following:
- Products
- Gifts
- Vouchers

10. Rewards are not redeemable for cash nor are they exchangeable for other Rewards under any circumstances. Rewards cannot be resold, exchanged, or transferred for value under any circumstances. Rewards shall not be regarded, construed, or used as valuable or exchangeable instruments under any circumstances.

11. Shopee retains the right to reject any Rewards that have been tampered with or found in any way unacceptable, or remove privilege of usage if deemed to have been linked to fraudulent activities.

12. Shopee is not responsible for any accidental usage or cancellation of Rewards, and no replacement will be provided in these circumstances.

General Terms & Conditions

13. Shopee may suspend the calculation and accrual of qualifying points to rectify any errors in calculation or adjust the calculation as it reasonably deems fit, without giving you prior notice or reason.

14. Fraud, abuse of redemptions or any dishonest activities related to the Brand Membership programme may result in the forfeiture of accumulated qualifying points and tier Rewards as well as, demotion of your membership tier, cancellation of your membership in the Brand Membership programme, or termination of your Shopee account.

15. To the extent as permitted by applicable laws, Shopee and Brand’s Official Shop reserves the right at any time to: 
- Vary, modify, or amend the terms and conditions of the Brand Membership programme (including adding or deleting any terms);
- Terminate or modify the Brand Membership programme;
- Revoke, adjust and/or recalculate any qualifying points awarded;
- Change the Rewards or substitutes any Reward with another of a similar value;
- Change the number of qualifying points that can be earned on spendings on qualifying transactions;
- Modify the qualifications and eligibility of earning qualifying points;
- Modify the activities that earn qualifying points;
- Modify the methods used to calculate the number of qualifying points to be awarded;
- Withhold or cease the awarding of qualifying points to you;
- Modify the qualifying points or other criteria for membership tier upgrades and renewals;
- Change or withdraw any benefits related to a particular membership tier; and/or
- Change the duration taken for qualifying points to expire; without prior notice to you and at its sole discretion.

referral_program_t_c_MX:
TÉRMINOS Y CONDICIONES
  Solo las inscripciones realizadas de forma correcta a través de un vínculo de invitación cumplen los requisitos de usuarios existentes y nuevos para las Shopee Monedas y el cupón, respectivamente.
  
  Las Shopee Monedas no son transferibles por dinero en efectivo.
  
  Las Shopee Monedas obtenidas en cuentas independientes no se pueden combinar en una cuenta de Shopee.
  
  No se puede usar el mismo dispositivo móvil para invitar a amigos y aceptar la invitación de un amigo. Shopee se reserva el derecho de realizar controles para evitar fraudes cuando sea necesario.
  
  Las invitaciones solo deben usarse con fines personales y no comerciales, y deben compartirse únicamente con contactos personales que valorarán la recepción de estas invitaciones. Los vínculos de invitaciones no deben publicarse ni distribuirse cuando no hay ningún fundamento razonable para creer que todos los destinatarios o, la mayoría de ellos, son amigos personales (como, por ejemplo, sitios web o foros de cupones).
  
  Un amigo invitado solo puede inscribirse con un vínculo de invitación. Si un amigo invitado recibe vínculos de invitaciones de varios Usuarios de Shopee, solo el Usuario de Shopee correspondiente cuyo vínculo de invitación utilizó el amigo invitado recibirá las Shopee Monedas.
  
  Shopee se reserva el derecho de suspender las cuentas o quitar las Shopee Monedas si se observa alguna actividad que se considere abusiva, fraudulenta o que infrinja los Términos del Servicio de Shopee. No reservamos el derecho de revisar e investigar todas las actividades de invitaciones y suspender las cuentas o modificar las invitaciones, a nuestra entera discreción, según se considere justo y adecuado.
  
  Shopee se reserva el derecho de cambiar estos Términos y Condiciones sin previo aviso, o retirar o interrumpir la opción Invitar y Ganar en cualquier momento sin previo aviso o responsabilidad hacia ninguna parte. En caso de discrepancia entre estos Términos y Condiciones y cualquier material de comercialización o promoción relacionado con la opción Invitar y Ganar, los Términos y Condiciones prevalecerán.

referral_program_t_c_SG:
Terms and Conditions

For the Referrer
o	The referral reward is only valid for users referred in Singapore. Referrers will receive the referral reward in the form of Shopee Coins. 
o	Coins will be credited to the referrer’s account automatically, after friends referred used the referrer’s code to make their first purchase on the Shopee app.
o	Only Shopee users who have registered for at least 10 days and has made a purchase on Shopee can refer new users. Users who do not meet this criteria will not be issued a referral code.
o	Shopee Coins awarded are not transferable to other accounts. Shopee Coins cannot be exchanged for cash or other incentives. 
o	Shopee Coins earned are still subject to expiry. 
o	If a new user has referral codes from multiple Shopee users, Shopee Coins will only be credited to the single account tied to the referral code used by the new user at checkout.

For Friends Referred
o	The same mobile device cannot be used to invite friends and accept a friend’s invitation. In addition, the new user should be downloading Shopee for the first time on his/her device. Shopee reserves the right to conduct fraud checks whenever necessary.
o	Only new users on Shopee, who have never made an order (including cancelled or refunded orders) on Shopee before, are eligible to use Referral codes.
o	The code is limited to one usage per user and can only be used on the first purchase. 
o	Referral code cannot be used together with any other voucher code or promotion.
o	The referral code is still subject to other conditions such as the code’s minimum spend and expiry.
o	Shopee reserves the right to disallow accounts from using the referral code, if we notice any activity that we believe is fraudulent. 

Shopee reserves the right to modify these Terms and Conditions without notice, or withdraw or discontinue this Referral incentive at any time without any prior notice.

Shopee reserves the right to suspend accounts and or remove Shopee Coins if we notice any activity that we believe is abusive, fraudulent, or in violation of the Shopee Terms of Service.
referral_program_t_c_TH:
ข้อกำหนดและเงื่อนไขการบริการ: 
1. เฉพาะผู้ที่ลงทะเบียนผ่านลิงค์เชิญเพื่อนสำเร็จแล้วเท่านั้นจึงจะได้รับรางวัล โดยผู้เชิญจะได้รับ Shopee Coins และผู้ถูกเชิญจะได้รับโค้ดส่วนลด 

2. ไม่สามารถแลกเปลี่ยนหรือทอน Shopee Coins เป็นเงินสดได้

3. คุณจะไม่ได้รับ Shopee Coins หากทำการลงทะเบียนมากกว่า 1 บัญชี และคุณไม่สามารถโอน Shopee Coins ระหว่างบัญชี หรือนำ Shopee Coins จากต่างบัญชีมารวมกันได้

4. คุณไม่สามารถใช้โทรศัพท์เครื่องเดียวกัน ในการชวนเพื่อน และรับคำเชิญที่ส่งจากโทรศัพท์เครื่องเดียวกันได้ ทาง Shopee ขอสงวนสิทธิ์ในการตรวจสอบการทุจริตในกรณีจำเป็น

5. คำเชิญนี้ใช้ได้เฉพาะบุคคลและไม่มีจุดประสงค์เพื่อการโฆษณาแต่อย่างใด คุณสามารถแชร์ลิงค์คำเชิญให้กับเพื่อน ครอบครัว หรือบุคคลใกล้ชิดที่ยินดีรับลิงค์คำเชิญเท่านั้น และคุณไม่สามารถแชร์ลิงค์คำเชิญบนหน้าเว็บไซต์ หรือบนเว็บที่บุคคลทั่วไปแสดงความเห็นในที่สาธารณะ

6. เพื่อนที่ถูกเชิญสามารถกดรับคำเชิญได้เพียงลิงค์เดียวเท่านั้น หากเพื่อนที่ถูกเชิญได้รับลิงค์คำเชิญมากกว่า 1 ครั้ง ผู้เชิญที่เป็นเจ้าของลิงค์ที่เพื่อนที่ถูกเชิญตอบรับเท่านั้น ที่จะได้รับ Shopee Coins

7. Shopee ขอสงวนสิทธิ์ในการระงับบัญชีผู้ใช้หรือยกเลิก Shopee Coins หากพบกิจกรรมที่ก่อให้เกิดอันตราย การทุจริต หรือการละเมิดเงื่อนไขการบริการของ Shopee และบริษัทขอสงวนสิทธิ์ในการตรวจสอบคำเชิญทุกคำเชิญ และระงับบัญชีผู้ใช้หรือแก้ไขคำเชิญตามความเหมาะสมและดุลพินิจของบริษัท

8. Shopee ขอสงวนสิทธิ์ในการเปลี่ยนแปลงกติกาและเงื่อนไขดังกล่าวโดยมิต้องแจ้งให้ทราบล่วงหน้า และขอสงวนสิทธิ์ในการเปลี่ยนแปลง ระงับ หรือยกเลิกกิจกรรม ชวนช้อป รับ Shopee Coins  โดยมิต้องแจ้งให้ทราบล่วงหน้า และไม่ขึ้นอยู่กับคำยินยอมจากฝ่ายใด และหากมีกรณีพิพาทเกิดขึ้นให้ยึดตามกติกาและเงื่อนไขทั้งหมดดังกล่าวข้างต้น
